items.title: zplane launches PEEL STEMS 2 with improved real-time stem separation
items.excerpt: zplane's PEEL STEMS 2 is an updated real-time AI stem-separation plugin that runs directly inside the DAW, cutting latency from 483ms to 245ms at 44.1kHz while improving separation quality. A concrete AI-audio craft upgrade for remixing, sampling and live workflows.

items.title: SpectraLayers 13 Takes 'Unmixing' To A New Level
items.excerpt: Steinberg's SpectraLayers 13 pushes AI-assisted unmixing further with tools like Unmix Chorus (separating lead from backing vocals), Voice Enhance and generative reconstruction, broadening the AI stem/spectral toolkit for producers and post-production.

items.title: You can now control FL Studio with an agentic AI chatbot from inside the DAW
items.excerpt: FL Studio 2026 introduces Gopher, an agentic AI chatbot that controls the DAW directly — organising tracks, routing mixer channels, setting levels, tweaking plugin parameters and generating Piano Roll content from natural-language prompts.

items.title: Pixelsncodes releases Lumen, a FREE open-source Windows synth that turns images into sound
items.excerpt: Lumen is a free, open-source Windows synth built with the Claude AI coding agent whose image-to-wavetable engine reads an image's bytes and turns them into a playable wavetable. A grassroots example of AI-vibe-coded instruments and cross-modal sound design.

items.title: AI Labeling: Two New Labels Are Meant to Tell You Whether AI Sang on Your Favorite Track
items.excerpt: Major industry bodies including IFPI, RIAA and BVMI introduce two new labels — 'AI-Generated' and 'AI-Assisted' — to flag whether AI was used on a recording, though the biggest streaming platforms have not yet adopted the system.

items.title: Why AI Song Generators Don't Grant Copyright
items.excerpt: An argument that AI song generators like Suno lack any mechanism to establish human authorship: the prompt-to-file design creates an 'authorship gap' that leaves creators without a defensible copyright claim over their AI-made tracks.
